investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-07-06T03:37–03:44Z with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the 6-node production cluster has zero schedulable nodes for new remote agent pods, with 2 nodes reporting insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and 4 nodes failing pod node affinity/selector matching. Because the pod never scheduled, the eval runner never received a VM ID or remote state, causing all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) to be absent and the expected-output contract to fail completely.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature (production-api environment) has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that match the remote agent pod's node affinity/selector. The remaining 4 nodes do not satisfy the pod's node affinity or selector constraints at all. Preemption cannot help because no lower-priority victims exist on the 2 eligible nodes. As a result, every remote agent pod creation attempt times out unscheduled (~144–146s), and no VM is ever provisioned, so the eval runner produces empty evidence and the contract assertions for vmIdPresent and remoteState cannot be evaluated.

Because the pod never scheduled, the eval runner never received a VM ID or remote state, causing all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) to be absent and the expected-output contract to fail completely.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature (production-api environment) has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that match the remote agent pod's node affinity/selector. As a result, every remote agent pod creation attempt times out unscheduled (~144–146s), and no VM is ever provisioned, so the eval runner produces empty evidence and the contract assertions for vmIdPresent and remoteState cannot be evaluated.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Eval Failure: Kubernetes Kata PeerPods VM Capacity Exhausted — All Three Remote-Agent Checks Unschedulable
investigations.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in the production-api environment with an identical Kubernetes scheduler message: the 6-node cluster has only 2 nodes carrying the kata.peerpods.io/vm resource, both of which are fully exhausted, while the remaining 4 nodes do not satisfy the pod's node affinity/selector. Because no remote agent pod could be scheduled, the eval runner's createAgent call never returned, no evidence was collected, and the expected-output contract for remote-agent-runtime (orgId, agentId, model, provider, message) was entirely unmet. This is an eval-infrastructure failure reflecting a real Kubernetes scheduling constraint; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the production-api remote-agent eval environment has exhausted the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource on the 2 nodes that carry it. When the eval runner calls createAgent with type "remote" (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs line 1918), the resulting pod is Unschedulable: 0/6 nodes are available — 2 have Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm and 4 do not match the pod's node affinity/selector. The pod remains pending until the eval timeout (~146 s), at which point the check fails with an empty evidence payload, violating all five required-evidence fields defined in infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json lines 266–269.

possibleCauses: Primary — kata.peerpods.io/vm resource exhaustion on the 2 eligible nodes: existing remote-agent pods or other workloads have consumed all available VM slots, leaving no capacity for new eval pods. Supported by the explicit 'Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm' message in all three sibling check failures (failed-check.message, sibling.remote-agent-create, sibling.remote-agent-state).

Secondary — node affinity/selector mismatch on 4 of 6 nodes: the remote-agent pod spec requires a node label or taint that only 2 nodes satisfy, meaning the effective scheduling pool is permanently constrained to those 2 nodes. If those 2 nodes are also at VM capacity, any new remote-agent pod will always be Unschedulable.

Tertiary — a previous eval run's remote-agent pod was not cleaned up (withCleanup in run-status-probes.mjs line 1916 may not have executed if an earlier run was interrupted), leaving a VM slot occupied and reducing available capacity for subsequent runs.
Lower confidence — a cluster-level quota or LimitRange on the kata.peerpods.io/vm resource was reduced, shrinking the total allocatable VM count on the 2 eligible nodes.
